body.p:
There was a man, [that] slept on the Small Sweetgrass hills. He saw in a dream, there was a man.
That was the one, which he slept on [viz. the butte]. He [the butte] said to him: I don't pity anybody. Now, if you give me a woman, I shall pity you. He said to him: Yes, I shall give you [a woman]. When he woke up, he went home. He took his youngest wife to that butte. They stood on it. Then he said: Partner, here is the woman, I give you. [He killed her.] Since that time that man became a great medicine-man in war [that means: he became a great warrior with supernatural power]. He became a chief by it.
